nodes.label: Flow Duration Curve
nodes.rationale: Represents streamflow against the proportion of time that flow is exceeded; annual deciles are derived from daily flows.

nodes.label: Nash Sutcliffe Model Efficiency
nodes.rationale: Evaluates observed versus modeled flow percentiles and zero-flow days. The authors treat efficiency above 0.7 as adequate and report weaker fits at several low-flow percentiles and Lambrechtsbos sites.

nodes.label: Afforestation Response Groups
nodes.rationale: Group 1 has larger low-flow reductions and more zero-flow days; Group 2 has more uniform proportional reductions. Storage differences are proposed as a partial explanation, not established as a measured causal result.

nodes.label: Ten Southern Hemisphere Catchments
nodes.rationale: Study dataset comprises catchments in southeastern Australia, South Africa, and New Zealand with diverse rainfall, soils, plantation species, and planted proportions.

nodes.label: Rainfall Plantation Age Adjustment
nodes.rationale: Fits annual flow percentiles using rainfall deviation and a sigmoidal plantation-age term, then substitutes average rainfall to isolate vegetation effects without requiring paired catchment observations.

nodes.label: Zero Flow Day Model
nodes.rationale: An inverse sigmoidal model characterizes increased stream intermittence at Stewarts Creek, Pine Creek, and Redhill; the paper cautions that these small, extensively afforested catchments may represent maximum effects.

nodes.label: Session-isolated task memory
nodes.rationale: Current task focus may persist inside a session but must not automatically carry over to a new session.

nodes.label: Short-term conversation memory tests
nodes.rationale: The current conversation must recall the requested travel FAQ and excluded release topic without relying on Mem0.

nodes.label: Cross-session user preference memory
nodes.rationale: Stable user preferences should transfer to a new session, while policy contacts from retrieved documents must not become user-profile facts.

nodes.label: Mem0 user and session fact memory
nodes.norm_label: mem0 user and session fact memory
nodes.rationale: Store extracted facts rather than transcripts; an LLM classifier determines user or session scope before Mem0 storage.

nodes.label: Redis sliding-window conversation memory
nodes.rationale: Store roughly 20 recent user and assistant messages per user and session in Redis, restore from PostgreSQL when expired and compress long histories into summaries.

nodes.rationale: Resume describes PyMuPDF and UnstructuredLoader parsing, OCR, SemanticChunker, bge embeddings, BM25, Milvus, and intent-driven routing among specialized knowledge sources.

nodes.label: Multimodal RAG Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Describes aligned text/image embeddings, Dots.OCR parsing, semantic chunking, Milvus dense and sparse indexes, short-term Redis memory, and long-term vector memory.
nodes.source_location: multimodal knowledge base project, extracted text lines 363–517

nodes.label: Vector Keyword Graph Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Combines pgvector semantic search, pg_trgm keyword search, RRF fusion, reranking, and optional Neo4j Text2Cypher retrieval to support content and relationship questions.

nodes.label: Neighbor Window Expansion
nodes.rationale: Matches small chunks but supplies adjacent same-book same-chapter chunks to preserve causal and narrative context; the resume reports answer point coverage increasing from 55.6% to 67.4% with a two-chunk window.

nodes.label: Corrective Adaptive RAG Evaluation
nodes.rationale: RAGAS evaluates retrieval and answer quality; failed retrieval can trigger another search or query rewriting, while persistent low confidence leads to human review.
nodes.source_location: multimodal project sections 5–6; medical project section 5

nodes.label: SQLGlot Execution Guard
nodes.rationale: Enforces read-only SQL, table allowlists, and row-level restrictions at the execution boundary rather than relying on prompt instructions.

nodes.rationale: Uses OpenSandbox for execution isolation and CompositeBackend routing for persistent memories and skills in MongoDB; progressive skill loading and combined MCP tools reduce context overhead.
